description_en: Submits a media file in synchronous mode for media information analysis
description_zh: 调用SubmitSyncMediaInfoJob以同步模式提交媒体文件进行媒体信息分析
kebab_example: aliyun ice submit-sync-media-info-job --name job-name --input Type=OSS Media=oss://bucket/path/to/video.mp4 --user-data user-data --schedule-config Priority=5 PipelineId=e37ebee5d98b4781897f6086e89f9c56 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitSyncMediaInfoJob

fields.description_en:

- OSS: an Object Storage Service (OSS) object.

- Media: a media asset.

fields.description_en:
The media object.

- If Type is set to OSS, set this parameter to the URL of an OSS object. Both the OSS and HTTP protocols are supported.

> Before you use the OSS bucket in the URL, you must add the bucket on the [Storage Management](~~609918~~) page of the Intelligent Media Services (IMS) console.

- If Type is set to Media, set this parameter to the ID of a media asset.
fields.description_zh:
媒体值：
- type 为 OSS 时，为 URL, 支持 OSS 协议和 HTTP 协议。
> URL中的 OSS bucket 需要先添加到IMS[存储管理](~~609918~~)后再使用。

- type 为 Media 时，为媒资 ID。
